events.title: Bad Hersfelder Festspiele: Abschlusskonzert 2026
events.description: The grand closing concert of the 75th Bad Hersfelder Festspiele in the vast medieval Stiftsruine church ruin rounds off the festival season (the edition ran 26 June - 16 August with 'Something Rotten!', 'Parzival', 'Lysistrata', 'Pippi Langstrumpf' and more).

events.title: Weinfest Fulda im Schlosshof
events.description: Fulda's baroque Schlosshof turns into one of eastern Hessen's most atmospheric late-summer venues. A dozen wine stands pour regional and national wines while live bands (pop, rock, evergreens — e.g. 5th Season) play nightly until the festival closes on 5 September.

events.title: Gießener Kultursommer 2026 (final weekend)
events.description: The anti-format open-air on historic Klosterberg hill above Giessen mixes indie, hip-hop, rock and pop on several stages against the monastery ruins. Big names H-Blockx, Kool Savas, Nena and James Arthur are confirmed for the edition running until 30 August.
events.cost_per_person: Day ticket ~40 EUR; some stages free

events.title: Marburger Weinfest (Spätsommer)
events.description: Marburg's old-town wine festival rounds out the August calendar on the Marktplatz, with regional wines, the university-town crowd, live music and food stalls extending into the evening across the historic Oberstadt.

events.title: documenta / Fridericianum: Charles Ray solo exhibition (opens)
events.description: The first major German institutional survey of American sculptor Charles Ray opens at the Fridericianum in the documenta year (until 3 Jan 2027): precise figurative sculptures in wood and stainless steel in the main hall of the 1779 museum.

events.title: Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe: Barocke Wasserspiele (sonntags)
events.description: The famous baroque water features of the UNESCO World Heritage Bergpark run every Wednesday, Sunday and Hessian holiday from 1 May to 3 October, starting 14:30 at the Kaskaden — a globally unique cascade theatre culminating at the Herkules statue.

events.title: Wein- & Altstadtfest Kelkheim-Münster
events.description: Old-town celebration on the Kirchplatz of Kelkheim-Münster with regional wines, Apfelwein and local specialities, live music and cosy Taunus village-fair atmosphere on the third weekend of August.

events.title: Fulda: Verkaufsoffener Sonntag & Stadtfest-Ausklang
events.description: A verkaufsoffener Sonntag rounds off the August weekend with the Fuldaer Innenstadt shops open for a relaxed browse — special atmosphere, local trends and a broad retail offer at the foot of the baroque cathedral.

events.title: Kulturzelt Kassel — late-summer concerts
events.description: Kassel's landmark Kulturzelt on the Fulda brings headliners to the big tent across the high summer and into September 2026 (line-up incl. MINE, Rainbirds and Rocko Schamoni). Every ticket doubles as an NVV Kombi-Ticket for public transport.

events.title: Regionale Kerb Hofheim-Lorsbach
events.description: The traditional Kirmes (Kerb) in Hofheim's Lorsbach district runs in late August with a festival tent, food stalls, music and fairground rides in the village centre — a typical Main-Taunus harvest-season celebration.

events.title: Weinbrunnenfest Michelstadt (Start)
events.description: One of the Odenwald's biggest folk festivals: from late August into early October the historic Altstadt of Michelstadt becomes a wine village with a funfair, crafts market and international food stalls. Bergsträßer wine and French specialities are trademarks.

events.title: Bad Homburger Laternenfest (Lantern Festival)
events.description: Hesse's most romantic traditional festival lights up Bad Homburg from Friday to Monday: lantern-adorned streets, two illuminated processions (Sat & Sun), live rock/pop on the Weed and in castle courtyards, plus cosy Altstadt Hinterhöfe.

events.title: Eschweger Wochenmarkt (Saturday)
events.description: The regional weekly market on Eschwege's Marktplatz offers local fruit, vegetables, baked goods and Werratal specialities (cherries, asparagus, honey) and crafts every Saturday morning — a reliable local shopping and tasting ritual in the Werra town.

events.title: Limburg: Wochenmarkt & Altstadtbummel
events.description: Limburg's Saturday market fills the streets beneath the 800-year-old Dom: regional produce, cheese, flowers and food stalls around the Kornmarkt, with the striking red-and-white cathedral and half-timbered old town as backdrop.
events.location: Kornmarkt Limburg, 65549 Limburg an der Lahn

events.title: Stadttheater Gießen: Sommerbühne — 'Sommerklänge' (Opernchor)
events.description: The Stadttheater Gießen, one of Hesse's five-discipline state theatres, runs its open-air Sommerbühne into late summer; a choral summer-evening concert showcases the Opernchor before the 2026/27 season's premieres.

events.title: Rheingau Musik Festival: Isidore String Quartet (Schloss Johannisberg)
events.description: The Isidore String Quartet plays the Fürst-von-Metternich-Saal at Schloss Johannisberg in one of the festival's closing concerts. The 2026 Rheingau Musik Festival (20 June - 5 Sept) staged 158 concerts at 26 venues in the Rheingau, Wiesbaden and the Taunus.

events.title: Rüdesheim: Stadttour mit allen Sinnen
events.description: A guided sensory city tour through Rüdesheim's romantic lanes: discover the Musikkabinett, the Drosselgasse and surrounding castles and vineyards while tasting regional food and wine. Led by the Rüdesheimer tourist board.

events.title: Herbstzauber Kassel — 20th anniversary garden festival
events.description: The award-winning park-and-garden staging 'Herbstzauber' marks 20 years with a jubilee weekend in the Staatspark Karlsaue and on the island of Siebenbergen: spectacular plantings, garden design, crafts, live music and autumnal colour.

events.title: Wetzlarer Brückenfest (Bridge Festival)
events.description: Wetzlar's big city festival between its famous Lahn bridges combines a sporty programme, city-fest flair and entertainment on stages in the Colchester-Anlage, am Eisenmarkt and Schillerplatz, plus a verkaufsoffener Sonntag on 6 September.

events.title: Annotopia Rotenburg a.d. Fulda — Steampunk- & Fantasiefestival
events.description: Professor Abraxo invites visitors on a journey through space and time: the Schlosspark of Rotenburg an der Fulda hosts a vivid steampunk and fantasy festival with costumed guests, artists, crafts and entertainment from 4 to 6 September.

events.title: 64. Hanauer Bürgerfest
events.description: Hanau's citizens' festival on the Mainwiesen at Schloss Philippsruhe (4-6 Sept) celebrates 64 editions with club stands, live stages, a children's programme and fireworks over the Main — family-friendly civic celebration in the Brüder-Grimm city.

events.title: Klingspor Museum Offenbach: 'Book Art from Prague' — Eröffnung
events.description: Opening of the exhibition 'Book Art from the Museum of Decorative Arts in Prague' at Offenbach's Klingspor Museum (4 Sept - 29 Nov 2026), a show of international book and lettering art from one of Europe's great decorative-arts collections.
events.location: Klingspor Museum, Herrnstraße 80, 63065 Offenbach am Main

events.title: 21. Kasseler Museumsnacht
events.description: Over 50 museums, galleries and cultural projects across Kassel open with a shared ticket for the 21st Museumsnacht, offering special programmes for all generations — from the Fridericianum documenta shows to the Caricatura gallery's live 'Zeichenzirkus'.

events.title: Bergsträßer Winzerfest Bensheim (Grape Press Festival)
events.description: The largest wine festival on the Bergstraße runs 5-13 Sept in Bensheim's old town: a 'Winzerdorf' (winemaker village), grand festival parade, wine tastings, live music and fireworks. Tasting stands are run by regional wineries.

events.title: Marburger Wochenmarkt & 'Marktweib Trude'
events.description: Marburg's Saturday market wraps around the medieval Marktplatz beneath the castle; guided tours tell the story of the famous 'Marktweib Trude' statue. Regional produce, cheese, game and university-town hustle.

events.title: Hanau: Radtour zur Industriekultur
events.description: A guided ~15 km bicycle tour through Hanau's industrial heritage from the Brüder-Grimm-Denkmal on the Marktplatz, organised by the municipal museums. German-language guided ride past historic and current industrial sites of the Grimm city.

events.title: Interkulturelles Fest Wetzlar — 'Vielfalt feiern'
events.description: Wetzlar's annual intercultural festival in the Klostergarten of the old town presents the city's cultural diversity with food, music, dance and community organisations under the motto 'Vielfalt feiern'.

events.title: documenta archiv: Bazon Brock zum 90. (last days)
events.description: Until 11 September the documenta archive shows a special exhibition on the artist and 'Künstler ohne Werk' Bazon Brock for his 90th birthday — a rare insight into his extensive literary estate before it closes.

events.title: ARTe Wiesbaden — Messe für zeitgenössische Kunst (RMCC)
events.description: The leading contemporary-art fair in the Wiesbaden region opens at the RheinMain CongressCenter (11-13 Sept): galleries, emerging artists, installations and art talks in the heart of the state capital.

events.title: Witzenhausen Wochenmarkt in 'Kirschenland'
events.description: In the cherry-growing heart of the Werratal ('Kirschenland'), the Saturday market on Witzenhausen's Marktplatz sells the region's famous cherries, cherries with cream, cherry brandy and local produce as the harvest season winds down.

events.title: Deutsches Goldschmiedehaus Hanau: 'Spuren legen' (Stadtmuseum Schloßplatz)
events.description: The special exhibition 'Spuren legen. Mit Materialität erzählen' at the Deutsches Goldschmiedehaus Hanau runs until 18 October 2026: nine international jewellery positions treating jewellery as a social and cultural carrier of meaning.

events.title: Michelstädter Kunsthandwerkmarkt im Stadtgarten
events.description: Artisans from across the Odenwald present handmade crafts in Michelstadt's Stadtgarten: pottery, woodwork, textiles, jewellery and regional produce, set in the historic town whose famous half-timbered Rathaus is nearby.

events.title: Umstädter Winzerfest Groß-Umstadt
events.description: Groß-Umstadt's traditional winemaker festival in the old town features regional wines from local wineries, food stands, live music and a festive atmosphere on a mid-September long weekend in the Odenwald-bordered town.

events.title: Saalburg: Thementage & Mitmachaktionen (Roman fort, Bad Homburg)
events.description: The reconstructed Roman fort Saalburg near Bad Homburg hosts themed days with hands-on activities for children and adults — Roman crafts, soldier life, marching and family trails at this UNESCO World Heritage Limes site.

events.title: Hofheim am Taunus: Science Slam
events.description: Researchers present their fields in an entertaining, jargon-free battle of short talks at Hofheim's city hall — part of the Main-Taunus autumn culture programme and the World Design Capital 2026 year.

events.title: Friedberger Herbstmarkt (Seewiese)
events.description: Friedberg's traditional autumn Volksfest runs 18-21 September on the Seewiese in the heart of the Wetterau's Kreisstadt: rides, food stands, shooting galleries, sweets and live music, about 10-15 minutes' walk from the station.

events.title: Limburger Brückenfest auf der Alten Lahnbrücke
events.description: Limburg celebrates on and around its medieval Alte Lahnbrücke: jesters, musicians, crafts market and a children's programme on the bridge, in Konrad-Kurzbold-Straße and on the Schleuseninsel — a charming old-town festival at the foot of the 800-year-old cathedral.
events.location: Alte Lahnbrücke / Altstadt, 65549 Limburg an der Lahn

events.title: Alte Musik Weilburg: Fauré-Requiem in der Schlosskirche
events.description: Concert 1 of the Alte Musik Weilburg 2026/27 series: Gabriel Fauré's 'Requiem' Op. 48 for soloists, choir and organ in the acoustically splendid Schlosskirche of the Weilburg palace — a contemplative autumn evening in the Lahn town.

events.title: Hanauer Herbstmesse (Jahrmarkt am Freiheitsplatz)
events.description: From 24 to 28 September, Hanau's showmen transform the central Freiheitsplatz into a classic amusement park: rides, shooting galleries, sweet-stall and snack stands, open daily 10:00-22:00 with free entry.

events.title: Centralstation Darmstadt: LAMBERT (Indie/Pop)
events.description: Belgian indie-pop project LAMBERT plays the Centralstation's Saal in Darmstadt's former central station, a leading Rhein-Main venue for concerts, readings, parties and culture in the Schlossgraben.

events.title: Wiesbadener Stadtfest — Herbstmarkt, Erntedank & verkaufsoffener Sonntag
events.description: Wiesbaden's big autumn city festival runs 25-27 September with a Herbstmarkt, an Erntedankfest around the Warmen Damm, live stages and a verkaufsoffener Sonntag on 27 September under the motto 'Deine Stadt - Deine Bühne'.

events.title: Herbstkerb Heldenbergen (Nidderau, Wetterau)
events.description: End-of-September village Kerb on the festival ground by the fire station in Nidderau-Heldenbergen: festival tent, fairground rides, food and the traditional 'Kerbe' spiel — typical of the Wetterau's autumn Kirmes season.

events.title: World Design Capital 2026: François Pisapia, Hofheim am Taunus
events.description: As part of the World Design Capital 2026 FrankfurtRheinMain year, the Main-Taunus-Kreis presents a design project with François Pisapia in Hofheim — part of the regional WAVA programme spanning Bad Soden, Eppstein, Flörsheim, Hattersheim, Hochheim, Hofheim and Kelkheim.

events.title: Centralstation Darmstadt: MEDLZ — 'Die 90er' (A-Cappella)
events.description: The a-cappella comedy group MEDLZ takes the Centralstation stage with their 90s-show, blending humour, beatboxing and vocal gymnastics in a celebration of nineties pop culture.

events.title: Rheingau Riesling Sommertour & Weinwanderungen (Herbst)
events.description: As the Riesling harvest approaches, the Rheingau offers guided wine walks and tastings through the terraced vineyards of Geisenheim, Rüdesheim and Johannisberg — a chance to taste young wine straight from the vines with winemakers.

events.title: Wiesbaden: Verkaufsoffener Sonntag zum Herbstmarkt
events.description: Stores across Wiesbaden's historic city centre open on the Sunday of the Herbstmarkt weekend, coinciding with the Erntedankfest — shopping, food stalls, wine stands and family entertainment across the Fünfeck, Kirchgasse and Wilhelmstraße.

events.title: Kelterfest Lorsch (OGV) — Apfelmost & Herbst
events.description: The Obst- und Gartenbauverein Lorsch hosts its Kelterfest with Apfelmost tasting, apple-juice sales and children's activities — a traditional cider-pressing harvest celebration at the World Heritage abbey town on the Bergstraße.

events.title: Wiesbadener Wiesn (Oktoberfest) — Eröffnung
events.description: Wiesbaden's own Oktoberfest opens on the Festplatz der Gibber Kerb (28 Sept - 15 Oct) with the traditional Fassanstich: an original Bavarian beer tent, Blasmusik, Wiesn-Schmankerl and rides — Wiesn feeling in the state capital.

events.title: Mohammed Sami 'Hostless' — Eröffnung im Fridericianum
events.description: Opening evening of Mohammed Sami's first institutional German exhibition 'Hostless' at the Fridericianum (3 Oct 2026 - 3 Jan 2027). The Iraq-born artist's enigmatic memory paintings of interiors and voids fill the documenta museum's main hall.

events.title: Weinbrunnenfest Michelstadt — Hauptwochenende
events.description: The Odenwald's largest folk festival peaks on the first October weekend (2-4 Oct): international cuisine, Bergsträßer wine, French specialities, live music and a full funfair and crafts market in Michelstadt's half-timbered Altstadt.

events.title: 4. Katzenberger Kelterfest (Vogelsberg, Seibelsdorf)
events.description: On the Dorfplatz of Seibelsdorf, the Eintracht Fanclub and Obst- und Gartenbauverein Antrifttal host the 4th Kelterfest with freshly pressed apple juice/most, local food and a cosy harvest atmosphere in the Vogelsberg countryside.

events.title: Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe: Wasserspiele (letzter Austragungstag)
events.description: The final day of the 2026 baroque Wasserspiele season in the UNESCO Bergpark before the winter break — the spectacular water cascade theatre at the Herkules statue and through the park runs on Hessian Unity Day (3 Oct).

events.title: Kassler Herbst-Ausstellung (Messe Kassel)
events.description: North Hesse's big consumer fair fills the eleven halls of Messe Kassel (3-11 Oct) with around 400 exhibitors on 30,000 m²: living, building, kitchen, fashion, food & drink, mobility and tourism — the region's largest seasonal exhibition.

events.title: Eschwege: Antik- & Sammlermarkt am Werdchen
events.description: On the Festplatz Werdchen, collectors and dealers gather for Eschwege's regular Antik- und Sammlermarkt (also on 6 Sept and 1 Nov 2026) — antiques, vinyl, old books, stamps, coins and collectibles in the Werra town.

events.title: Weilburger Residenzmarkt
events.description: The traditional Weilburger Residenzmarkt fills the old town with music, market stalls and culinary delights, paired with a verkaufsoffener Sonntag on 11 October (12:00-18:00): craft, regional produce and palace-town flair on the Lahn.

events.title: Marburger Elisabethmarkt
events.description: Marburg's regional, creative autumn market festival takes over the inner city on 10-11 October: artisans, regional food, live music and a family programme around the Marktplatz and Oberstadt beneath the Elisabethkirche and castle.

events.title: Staatstheater Wiesbaden: 'Hoffmanns Erzählungen' (Premiere)
events.description: Jacques Offenbach's opera fantastique 'Hoffmanns Erzählungen' (The Tales of Hoffmann) has its 2026/27 season premiere in the Großes Haus of the Hessisches Staatstheater Wiesbaden — one of the autumn's great opera highlights in the state capital.

events.title: Hanau: Friedrich Becker Preis 2026 (Schloss Philippsruhe, lasts days)
events.description: The prestigious goldsmithing/jewellery award exhibition at Schloss Philippsruhe runs until 18 October, showcasing works by laureates of the Friedrich Becker Preis — a highlight for design and craft in the 'Deutsche Goldschmiedehaus' region.

events.title: Staatstheater Wiesbaden: 'Footloose' (Premiere Saison 26/27)
events.description: The dance-musical hit 'Footloose' opens the new 2026/27 season of the Hessisches Staatstheater Wiesbaden, one of several autumn premieres alongside 'La Bohème', 'Hoffmanns Erzählungen' and 'Carmina Burana'.

events.title: Alexander Eder Unplugged — Akustik-Tour (Capitol Offenbach)
events.description: Entertainer and talent-show winner Alexander Eder plays his acoustic live show with band at the Capitol Theater Offenbach, a celebrated Rhein-Main concert and event location on the Goethestraße.
events.location: Capitol Theater, Goethestraße 1-5, 63067 Offenbach am Main

events.title: Wiesbaden-Biebrich: Herbsttage & verkaufsoffener Sonntag
events.description: The Biebrich district's autumn days (Herbsttage) bring shops, food stalls, music and a verkaufsoffener Sonntag to Wiesbaden-Biebrich, the former residence district alongside the Biebrich Palace on the Rhine.

events.title: Bad Nauheim: Steven Pitman's Elvis Weekend
events.description: Bad Nauheim, the 'German Graceland' where Elvis lived in the 1960s, hosts its two-day Elvis Weekend (16-17 Oct) with tribute artists Jimmy Holmes, Emilio Santoro, Moses Snow, RIO, Arron Walker and Gordon Davis.

events.title: Darmstädter Heinerwiesn (Oktoberfest)
events.description: Darmstadt's own Oktoberfest pitches its large festival tents on a central site from mid-October: Bavarian brass bands, dirndl-and-lederhosen atmosphere, beer tents, rides and folk-fest food in the Wissenschaftsstadt.

events.title: Maggie Reilly — 'Everytime We Touch' Tour 2026 (Orangerie Fulda)
events.description: Scottish singer Maggie Reilly, the voice behind Mike Oldfield's 'Moonlight Shadow', brings her hits to the Orangerie in Fulda's Maritim hotel, with special guest Julia Neigel & Band on the 'Everytime We Touch Tour 2026'.

events.title: David Bowie Symphony — The Celebration Concert (Offenbach)
events.description: A symphonic tribute to David Bowie at the Capitol Theater Offenbach: an orchestra and vocalists reinterpret Bowie's greatest songs from 'Space Oddity' to 'Heroes' in a celebration concert.
events.location: Capitol Theater, Goethestraße 1-5, 63067 Offenbach am Main

events.title: Alte Musik Weilburg: Liederabend im Komödienbau
events.description: Concert 2 of the Alte Musik Weilburg series: a song recital ('Liederabend am leuchtenden Sommermorgen') with late-Romantic song repertoire in the Aula des Komödienbaues — a refined chamber-evening in the Weilburg residence town.

events.title: XXL Flohmarkt Messehallen Kassel
events.description: One of Hesse's biggest flea markets with several hundred dealers in the Messe Kassel halls and the outdoor grounds: second-hand, antiques, collectibles, vinyl, clothing and household goods draw bargain hunters from across North Hesse.

events.title: Casseler Herbst-Freyheit (mittelalterlicher Markt, Innenstadt)
events.description: From 29 Oct to 1 Nov, Kassel's inner city (Königsplatz, Friedrichsplatz, Opernplatz) hosts the Casseler Herbst-Freyheit: a medieval craft market, family Kirmes and autumn market with historical performances and culinary offerings.

events.title: Herbstmesse Alsfeld (Erlebnis-Herbstmesse Hessenhalle)
events.description: Verkaufsmesse for trade, crafts, health and tourism covering the Schwalm, Vogelsberg and Wetterau regions at the Hessenhalle Alsfeld, 30 Oct - 1 Nov: home & renovation, tourism & health, lifestyle and food exhibitors plus family programme.

events.title: Kassel Kultur-Herbst: documenta-Jahres-Ausstellungen (Tipp)
events.description: Kassel's museums run into the autumn with the documenta-year shows at Fridericianum (Charles Ray, Mohammed Sami), GRIMMWELT's comics-and-animals exhibition and the Neue Galerie — a rich art weekend destination in North Hesse.

events.title: GRIMMWELT Kassel: 'Ich, das Tier' — Comics & Tierzeichnungen
events.description: The ongoing GRIMMWELT special exhibition (through early 2027) explores animals in comics from the big bad wolf to Donald Duck — with interactive stations where visitors can design their own comics and transform into a creature.
